$comment: Single source for every page's <title>, description, breadcrumb name and sitemap entry. Used at runtime by PageMeta and at build time by scripts/prerender.mjs. Keep titles under ~60 characters and descriptions between ~120 and 160. `sources` are the files whose last git commit date becomes the page's sitemap <lastmod> and schema dateModified.

/.name: Home
/.title: Settsmartly: Split Rent, Bills & Expenses with Flatmates
/.description: The household expense app for flatmates in India. Split rent, bills and groceries, track who paid and settle up every month, with an AI voice assistant.

/features.name: Features
/features.title: Features: Expense Splitting, Bills & Voice | Settsmartly
/features.description: Smart expense splitting, a shared household workspace, bill reminders, roommate move-in and move-out, UPI settle-up and monthly insights for flatmates.

/voice-assistant.name: Voice Assistant
/voice-assistant.title: AI Voice Expense Tracker in Hindi & Hinglish | Settsmartly
/voice-assistant.description: Add shared expenses by speaking in English, Hindi or Hinglish. The AI assistant drafts the amount, payer and split, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

/flatmates.name: For Flatmates
/flatmates.title: Flatmate & Roommate Expense Tracker for India | Settsmartly
/flatmates.description: Share a rented flat? Track rent, electricity, Wi-Fi and groceries, handle flatmates moving in or out, and settle up monthly. Beta starting in Bengaluru.

/how-it-works.name: How It Works
/how-it-works.title: How Settsmartly Works: Split Flat Expenses in 6 Steps
/how-it-works.description: Create your household, invite flatmates, add expenses by voice or by hand, put rent and bills on autopilot and settle up every month with Settsmartly.

/pricing.name: Pricing
/pricing.title: Pricing: Free Expense Splitting for Flats | Settsmartly
/pricing.description: Splitting expenses, balances and your own records will always be free. Optional Plus, Premium and Household plans add the voice assistant and bill automation.

/about.name: About Us
/about.title: About Settsmartly: Household Finance for Shared Living
/about.description: Settsmartly is building India's household finance platform for people who live together, starting with flatmates and working professionals in Bengaluru.

/contact.name: Contact
/contact.title: Contact Settsmartly: Support, Beta & Partnerships
/contact.description: Contact the Settsmartly team about the beta, product feedback, partnerships, press or business enquiries. Send us a message and a real person will reply.
